high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from marktechpost.com, displaying an article about new training strategies introduced for a model called mmBERT. The page is titled "What new training strategies were introduced?" and discusses three main innovations that drive mmBERT's performance. Annealed Language Learning (ALL): Languages are introduced gradually (60 → 110 → 1833). Sampling distributions are annealed from high-resource to uniform. This ensures low-resource languages gain influence during later stages without overfitting limited data. **Inverse Masking Schedule
